summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py (added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and Tuple[ControlType, str] in ControlCode); rich/control.py (OSC 0 format entry and Control.title classmethod with docstring); rich/_windows_renderer.py (new elif branch calling term.set_title); rich/console.py (Console.set_window_title gated only on is_terminal, with docstring); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200); tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, so tests and mypy are unverified. Open point: on dumb terminals set_window_title returns True without writing, because control() skips buffering; the spec's terminal-only gate was followed as written.
